aboutUs.title: ABOUT US
aboutUs.subTitle: Our Promise
description: Welcome to MATJO – the Asian restaurant in Dresden Neustadt. On Alaunstraße you can enjoy Korean BBQ and Chinese Hotpot under one roof.
We combine the best traditions of Korean BBQ and Chinese Hotpot for a unique culinary experience in Dresden.
With us, you create your meal to your taste: fresh ingredients, authentic flavours and warm service in a relaxed atmosphere.
Spend an unforgettable evening with your loved ones – or have BBQ and Hotpot delivered to your door.

valueList.heading: Quality
valueList.description: We focus on fresh, high-quality ingredients to guarantee an exceptional taste experience.

valueList.heading: Authenticity
valueList.description: We value traditional preparation methods and recipes to offer you an authentic experience.

valueList.heading: Hospitality
valueList.description: Warmth and friendliness are the heart of our service, so you feel right at home with us.

valueList.heading: Community
valueList.description: Food brings people together, and at MATJO, sharing and enjoying is at the core of our experience.

faqList.title: How is BBQ served at MATJO in Dresden?
faqList.content: Alongside numerous meat and vegetable dishes, many side dishes are served – known in Korean cuisine as Banchan. These include kimchi, pickled vegetables and rice. Grilled dishes are wrapped in lettuce leaves and dipped in sauces and spices.

faqList.title: What ingredients are in the Hotpot?
faqList.content: Our Chinese Hotpot contains a variety of fresh ingredients such as vegetables, meat and noodles, which you can combine as you like – perfect for sharing a meal in Dresden.

faqList.title: Are there vegetarian options?
faqList.content: Yes, we offer a selection of vegetarian ingredients for the Hotpot as well as special vegetarian BBQ dishes.

faqList.title: Can allergies be accommodated?
faqList.content: Absolutely! Please inform our staff about your allergies so that we can prepare a safe and delicious meal for you.

faqList.title: Are reservations required?
faqList.content: We recommend making reservations, especially on weekends, to ensure you get a table at our Asian restaurant in Dresden. Walk-ins are also welcome!
